provenance.researchScope: Three original exact selected paintings from Wikimedia Commons; API photo rights and original SHA-1/SHA-256 checked against downloaded bytes. Rights claims remain under jurisdiction-specific and platform release review.

works.title: The Adoration of the Magi
works.visualFinding: Excellent densely populated horizontal work with the complete central Magi narrative; a 9:16 cover crop would eliminate essential actors. Full aspect ratio required for phone and desktop.

works.title: The Immaculate Conception
works.visualFinding: Composition is naturally portrait and can be preserved without cropping. Remains a source-image candidate until optical quality, frame-free and app usage rights are signed off.

works.title: Pentecost
